info.title: Crehler Payment Bundle - Saved Card Tokens
info.description: Store API endpoint for retrieving customer's saved payment card tokens. Cards are tokenized by the payment gateway and stored for recurring use.

get.description: Returns a list of payment cards previously saved (tokenized) by the customer through the payment gateway. Only available for authenticated non-guest customers. Guest customers always receive an empty collection.

elements.description: List of saved payment cards. Empty array for guest customers or customers with no saved cards.

SavedCardStruct.description: A single saved payment card token.

token.description: Opaque token identifying the saved card at the payment gateway. Used when initiating a payment with a saved card.

brandImgUrl.description: URL to the card brand logo image.

status.description: Current status of the card token at the payment gateway.

cardNumberMasked.description: Masked card number showing only the last 4 digits.

preferred.description: Whether this card is marked as the customer's preferred/default card. Defaults to false.

cardScheme.description: Optional card scheme identifier (e.g. for co-branded cards).
